+++ b/models/utils_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	const cveID = "CVE-2024-5732"
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel(cveID, []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{
+			Source: "nvd@nist.gov",
+			Cvss3:  cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.3},
+		}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{
+				Source: "nvd@nist.gov",
+				Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{
+					BaseScore:    8.2,
+					VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N",
+					BaseSeverity: "HIGH",
+				},
+			},
+			{
+				Source: "cna@example.com",
+				Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{
+					BaseScore:    6.9,
+					VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N",
+					BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM",
+				},
+			},
+		},
+	}})
+
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("ConvertNvdToModel() returned %d contents, want 2", len(contents))
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent, len(contents))
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		if content.Type != Nvd || content.CveID != cveID {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected NVD content identity: %+v", content)
+		}
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+
+	nvd := bySource["nvd@nist.gov"]
+	if nvd.Cvss40Score != 8.2 || nvd.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N" || nvd.Cvss40Severity != "HIGH" || nvd.Cvss3Score != 7.3 {
+		t.Errorf("NVD source metrics were not retained together: %+v", nvd)
+	}
+	cna := bySource["cna@example.com"]
+	if cna.Cvss40Score != 6.9 || cna.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N" || cna.Cvss40Severity != "MEDIUM" || cna.Cvss3Score != 0 {
+		t.Errorf("CNA source metrics were not preserved: %+v", cna)
+	}
+}
